distribution.title: WP I of project CROSSPRO aims to systematically analyses the stakeholder discourse on alternative proteins in four Member States (France, italy, Germany, Netherlands) of the European Union and explore how such discourse is reflected in their national policy frameworks. The stakeholder discourse selected from this analysis are: farmers and consumer advocacy groups. Data collected are relevant materials available on their websites i.e. original posts, articles, statements, opinion papers, videos. These materials allows to explore the stakeholders' opinions on alternative proteins development, commercialisation and adoption.

dataset.title: CROSSPRO - Data Management Plan -WP1

dmp.description:
The project CROSSPRO aims to provide a comprehensive analysis of the political and regulatory factors shaping public discourse and cultural acceptance of alternative proteins in the European Union. Based on this analysis, the project will develop targeted policy recommendations to support a just and inclusive transition for consumers and stakeholders who are currently dependent on conventional livestock farming, such as farmers and rural communities. 
Data will be collected throughout the project. Data will consists of: 1) public available materials i.e. articles, blog posts, public statements, made by relevant stakeholders; 2) original data acquired through semi-structured qualitative interviews; 3) original data acquired through focus groups.
